bibleState.subject: Whether memories kept by a machine are still one's own.
bibleState.thematic_question: If a machine keeps your memories more faithfully than you can, are they still yours?
bibleState.stance:
No. The ending suggests that a memory is partly the act of keeping it: what the house archive returns to Ilse is accurate but no longer hers.

One condition holds throughout: a memory told aloud to someone else stays alive, however perfect the record.
